fields.label: Enable Late Entry & Early Exit Penalty Rules

fields.description: Minutes after shift start / before shift end that are free. No application needed; no pool count and no half-day deduction within this window.
fields.label: Late Entry / Early Exit Grace Mins

fields.description: Maximum delay still treated as a minor (pool) late/early. Between grace and this value: counts toward the monthly pool if no approved application. Beyond this value: immediate half-day (unless covered by half-day leave / Office Work).
fields.label: Late Entry / Early Exit Max Delay Mins

fields.description: Number of free late/early occurrences in the grace→max band (no application) before the first half-day. Example: 2 means first 2 free, 3rd deducts half-day.
fields.label: Initial Grace Occurrences (Before 1st Half-Day Deduction)

fields.description: After a half-day penalty from the pool, this many further occurrences are free before the next half-day. Example: 2 means two free, then another half-day.
fields.label: Subsequent Grace Step Occurrences (Per Additional Half-Day Deduction)

fields.description: If enabled, late and early pool occurrences share one combined monthly tally for half-day / full-day penalties.
fields.label: Combine Late Entry & Early Exit Occurrence Pool

fields.description: When enabled, if the monthly unexcused late/early pool count is greater than the threshold below, occurrence penalties are deducted as full-day absent (gross) instead of half-day (basic).
fields.label: Enable Full-Day Absent Escalation After Pool Threshold

fields.description: If unexcused late/early pool count in the payroll month is greater than this number, deduct full-day absent instead of half-day for the occurrence penalties.
fields.label: Full-Day Absent After More Than (Pool Occurrences)

fields.description: When enabled, Late Entry and Early Exit Applications must be filed within the max days below after the attendance date.
fields.label: Enable Late / Early Application Submission Deadline

fields.description: Max days after the attendance date to submit a Late Entry or Early Exit Application. Example: 2 means the form must be filed within 2 days of that attendance date.
fields.label: Max Days to Submit Late / Early Application
Block Leave Application on Sandwich Rule Violation
Max Paid Out of Office Hours Per Day

fields.description: ASR policy: when an approved Leave Without Pay application length is at or above the threshold, LWP days on the salary slip are deducted using gross daily rate instead of basic.
fields.label: Enable Continuous LWP Gross Salary Deduction (ASR)

fields.description: Per Leave Application length in days (to_date − from_date + 1). If any LWP application covering the payroll period is at least this many days, LWP deduction uses gross salary.
fields.label: Continuous LWP Threshold Days (ASR)
Last BS Allocation Year
fields.description: Watermark for the monthly BS leave allocation job. Do not confuse with the current BS date held in Nepal Compliance Settings.

fields.label: Salary Breakdown
fields.description: How the Salary Structure Assignment breakdown converts to pay. Base always equals Basic + Dearness Allowance + Grade + Other Allowances.

fields.label: Daily Rate Divisor
fields.description: Days used to convert monthly salary to a daily rate for absence / LWP / late deductions. Nepali practice is a fixed 30. Set to 0 to use the slip's Total Working Days instead.

fields.label: Default Basic Salary %
fields.description: When only Base is entered (e.g. via Bulk Salary Structure Assignment), Basic Salary is derived as this percent of Base and the remainder becomes Other Allowance. SSF requires basic to be at least 60% of remuneration.

fields.label: Include Grade in SSF / PF / Gratuity Base
fields.description: Grade increments are normally treated as basic remuneration. Uncheck only if your SSF registration says otherwise.

fields.label: Include Dearness Allowance in SSF / PF / Gratuity Base
fields.description: Off by default: DA is part of the statutory minimum wage but is not normally part of basic remuneration for contribution purposes.

fields.label: Overtime Rate Multiplier
fields.description: Overtime is paid at this multiple of the normal hourly rate. Labour Act 2074 s.31 sets 1.5x, and caps overtime at 4 hours a day / 24 hours a week. Baked into the Overtime formula when you run Setup.

fields.label: Government Minimum Wage
fields.description: Fixed by the Minimum Remuneration Fixation Committee and revised every two years. Nepal states the minimum as Basic + Dearness Allowance separately, so both floors are enforced independently as well as on the total.

fields.label: Enforce Minimum Wage on Salary Structure Assignment
Minimum Monthly Basic Salary
fields.description: आधारभूत तलब floor. The basic half of the statutory minimum wage. Note: your existing Basic Salary formula hardcodes 12170 - set whichever figure is current.

fields.label: Minimum Monthly Dearness Allowance
fields.description: \u092e\u0939\u0901\u0917\u0940 \u092d\u0924\u094d\u0924\u093e floor. The DA half of the statutory minimum wage.

fields.label: Minimum Monthly Remuneration (Basic + DA)
fields.description: Combined floor. Basic + Dearness Allowance on an assignment must reach this, on top of each component clearing its own floor above.

fields.label: Component Account Mapping
fields.description: Maps each kind of payroll posting to a GL account, per company. Running Setup assigns these to every Salary Component it creates, so you do not have to open each component to set its account. Wages and Salary are separate purposes because they post to different expense accounts.

fields.label: Setup Help
fields.options: Creates the Nepal salary components, four salary structures (SSF and PF/Gratuity, each in a Wages and a Salary variant), and the income tax slab — then applies the account mapping above. Safe to re-run: existing records are updated, never duplicated. Structures already on the site are left untouched.
